text: Welcome to the Shield of Achilles Engineering Log. Twenty verified LDraw kits total twenty-four thousand six hundred and thirty-one pieces with zero clashes.
Clicking any of the eight monumental forty-eight by thirty-two stage dioramas highlights its bonded museum plinth, custom beasts, and exact Homeric line.
Launching the interactive Three.js WebGL studio lets builders orbit, explode layers, and inspect every stud bond across all twenty kits.
Finally, the four-angle contact sheets and BFS graph checker confirm that every kit lifts out of the shield in one piece.
